name: @local/dsh-reflex
description: Reflex engine tools for the DeepSeek Harness — a thin client for the Reflex command server (JSON over TCP, default 127.0.0.1:49173) that runs inside the Gauge host. Tools: reflex_status, reflex_windows, reflex_capture_display, reflex_capture_window, reflex_click, reflex_type, reflex_key, reflex_ax, reflex_command. The engine keeps ONE home (the Gauge host, with its TCC grants); this plugin never duplicates it.
